summary: Escalate per Risk Gate at 0.73 confidence. F1 confirms 8 suspicious sign-ins from Cloudvault VPS (DE) outside account baseline {T1078.004}. F3 confirms VPN appliance vpn-edge-01 (firmware 22.7R2.2) runs CISA KEV-listed product with multiple CVEs {T1133,T1190}. F2 indicates most sign-ins originate from DE (8 events). Sign-in path touches an exposed asset; partial chain lacks confirmed abuse.

actions.action: Reset password and revoke all sessions for s.demir@aegean.edu; investigate sign-ins from Cloudvault VPS (DE).
Patch or isolate vpn-edge-01 and review VPN authentication logs for exploitation.
Enforce MFA and geo-based conditional access for DE ASN sign-ins.
Hunt for lateral movement from the VPN appliance edge into campus network.

risk.rationale: Verified evidence shows suspicious valid-account sign-ins from a non-baseline Cloudvault VPS (DE) and a KEV-listed VPN appliance with exploitable remote-access flaws, but there is no confirmed exploitation of the VPN or confirmed malicious post-auth activity to prove a completed account-takeover chain. The signals are not explained away (not benign) and exceed a weak unexplained signal; the KEV exposure plus insufficient linkage warrants human review.
